sub_sector.value: defaulted consumer debt purchasing; collections and receivables servicing

financial_business_type.detail: Specialty finance buying defaulted receivables portfolios and collecting; also debt servicing and portfolio management.

revenue_driver.detail: Collections on purchased defaulted receivables; smaller servicing fees for third-party accounts.

customer_type.detail: Collects from consumers; buys portfolios from banks, credit unions, utilities and retailers.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Deploys own capital to purchase receivables portfolios, bearing collection risk; servicing is minor.
